context: Ren reports market conditions to Hiroshi-boss.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business report; vocabulary (条約/混乱/主要/景気/相場) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 相場が、不安定になっています。
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: What's the cause of the turmoil?
lines.style: attentive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 主要国の条約交渉が、原因です。
lines.en: Major nations' treaty talks are the cause.
lines.style: precise young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 我が社の景気は、大丈夫かね?

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 景気の波に、備えています。
lines.en: We're prepared for the economic waves.
lines.style: confident young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 相場を、注意深く見てくれ。
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 主要な取引先とも、相談します。
lines.en: I'll consult our main clients too.
lines.style: reliable young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 混乱の中こそ、冷静に行こう。
lines.en: Especially amid turmoil, let's stay calm.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
